facts.en: Completed an operations support diploma at Fictional Dawnmoss College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构晨苔学院完成运营支持文凭课程。

facts.en: Attended an internal process-mapping workshop in 2022-05 without receiving an external certification.
facts.zh: 2022-05 参加内部流程梳理工作坊，未获外部认证。

facts.en: Records assistant at Fictional Oak Current, 2020-09 to 2023-03.
facts.zh: 2020-09 至 2023-03 在虚构橡流机构任记录助理。

facts.en: Process support associate at Fictional Oak Current, 2023-04 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2026-09 在虚构橡流机构任流程支持专员。

facts.en: Records request handoffs and highlights incomplete approval fields for team leads.
facts.zh: 记录请求交接，并向团队负责人标出不完整的审批字段。

facts.en: Helped introduce an approval checklist with a process manager in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与流程经理共同引入审批核对表。

facts.en: Personally maintained the checklist spreadsheet and collated weekly observations; the manager approved the process change.
facts.zh: 个人维护核对表电子表格并汇总每周观察；流程变更由经理批准。

facts.en: In 2025-02, median elapsed processing time was 5 days among 24 completed requests observed by the team.
facts.zh: 2025-02，团队观察的 24 个已完成请求的处理历时中位数为 5 天。

facts.en: In 2025-05, median elapsed processing time was 4 days among 28 completed requests observed by the team.
facts.zh: 2025-05，团队观察的 28 个已完成请求的处理历时中位数为 4 天。

facts.en: Staffing levels and request complexity changed between the observation periods, so the checklist effect was not isolated.
facts.zh: 观察期间之间人员配置及请求复杂度发生变化，因此未单独识别核对表的效果。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet timestamps, median calculations, and meeting action logs.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格时间戳、中位数计算及会议行动日志。

facts.en: Drafted a handoff escalation diagram in 2026-02; it was reviewed but not rolled out by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草交接升级处理图；截至 2026-09 已审阅但未推广。

facts.en: Follows up assigned action items without setting departmental targets or approving staffing.
facts.zh: 跟进分配的行动项，不制定部门目标或批准人员配置。

facts.en: Built a personal catalogue of 34 imaginary board-game cards in 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2024-06 为 34 张假想桌游卡牌制作个人目录。

facts.en: Enjoys cycling and repairing paper book covers.
facts.zh: 爱好骑行及修补纸质书封面。
